architecture.base_text: Master V3 (King Fahd Complex revised, vetted text)

guidelines.rule_zero: DO NOT OVERKILL. Do not rewrite natural, accurate Thai sentences. Preserve King Fahd phrasing unless there is an Arabic omission, factual defect, or genuine typo.
guidelines.de_overkill_spacing: Thai is written continuously without spaces between words. Remove unnecessary, unnatural, or chopped-up spaces. Keep spaces ONLY for natural breath pauses, dialogue breaks, list items, or clause boundaries. Never space inside compound words.
guidelines.footnote_placement: Verify that [FN:N] markers sit at the END of the concept or phrase they explain (e.g. after the full term 'อะลิฟ ลาม มีม[FN:1]', not mid-word). No space before [FN:N]. Do NOT mechanically add a space after [FN:N] if the sentence continues naturally in Thai; keep spaces after [FN:N] ONLY for natural clause/sentence boundaries.
guidelines.spelling: Follow Royal Institute Thai dictionary and standard Islamic transliteration with Phinthu (ฺ).

canonical_terms.Qiyamah: วันกิยามะฮฺ
